body:
## Change

F1. Rebase mutations on latest readable settings while retaining unsaved local field patches. Clear pending fields only after successful persistence. Sequential stale-tab writes preserve unrelated values; best-effort live settings survive quota failures.

## Validation

V1. Original stale-session regression failed before change. Parent caught introduced quota-failure regression before publication: second mutation lost prior unsaved setting. Separate repair worker added repeated-failure, recovery, remote-field and dirty-clearing tests.
V2. Parent reviewed repaired merge logic and reran all 5 focused tests plus independent Node quota reproduction: PASS. Worker related: 37; contracts: 87, typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. No atomic multi-tab transaction, storage-event live sync or background retry. Truly overlapping read/write sequences can still race; pending changes survive only in current store until successful later mutation. Store fixtures, not native multi-tab browser proof. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(shell): preserve unrelated settings across stale sessions
